image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) perched on a textured, mossy rock. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular yellow spots and bands. Its skin appears wet and smooth. The head is broad with visible parotoid glands behind the eyes. The limbs are short and stout, gripping the rock surface. The tail extends downwards, showing the characteristic black and yellow pattern.
